use_case_title: Mainframe COBOL Modernization and DevX Improvement
description: DIR and multiple agencies modernize aging COBOL-based mainframe applications and mitigate COBOL skills gaps by using tools like AMI DevX and moving selected applications to other platforms. This improves developer productivity, accelerates change delivery on critical systems, and supports long-term mainframe modernization goals.
ppt_source_file: FY26 State of Texas 10X Mindset - Jeff Ebbrecht AM 08292025.pptx

use_case_title: Mainframe Security, Resiliency, and Disaster Recovery Compliance
description: To meet DIR mandates on security, resiliency, and disaster recovery, agencies such as the Texas Comptroller of Public Accounts and DIR-managed mainframe environments replace or augment IBM security solutions with offerings like AMI Security. Strengthening mainframe cybersecurity improves compliance, reduces audit risk, and protects mission-critical state systems.
ppt_source_file: FY26 State of Texas 10X Mindset - Jeff Ebbrecht AM 08292025.pptx

use_case_title: Mainframe Operations Cost Optimization and Performance Insight
description: Agencies address budget constraints and the need for cost transparency by adopting AMI Ops, AMI Ops Automation, AMI Storage, and AMI Ops Insights for mainframe monitoring and automation. These tools help them do more with less by optimizing capacity, automating routine operations, and improving visibility into performance and resource consumption.
ppt_source_file: FY26 State of Texas 10X Mindset - Jeff Ebbrecht AM 08292025.pptx

use_case_title: Hybrid Cloud–Mainframe Integration for Digital Services
description: State agencies modernize legacy systems and enhance digital service delivery for over 30 million residents by integrating mainframe data and processing with applications running on AWS and Azure, using capabilities such as AMI Cloud, AMI Data, and Control-M SaaS. This hybrid approach preserves mainframe systems of record while enabling more agile, cloud-based citizen services and unified workload visibility.
ppt_source_file: FY26 State of Texas 10X Mindset - Jeff Ebbrecht AM 08292025.pptx

use_case_title: Enterprise Workload Automation Standardization with Control-M SaaS
description: Texas agencies including TxDOT, the Comptroller of Public Accounts, Health and Human Services, the Railroad Commission, and DIR-run HHS systems replace disparate schedulers such as JobTrac and ActiveBatch and migrate existing Control-M deployments to Control-M SaaS. Control-M orchestrates critical application workloads—such as TxDOT’s PeopleSoft processes and HHSC’s CAPS application—improving reliability of batch and data pipelines, simplifying cross-platform orchestration, and providing a unified operational view.
ppt_source_file: FY26 State of Texas 10X Mindset - Jeff Ebbrecht AM 08292025.pptx

use_case_title: Cloud-Based Virtual Tape Library Modernization for Mainframe Backup
description: The Texas Comptroller of Public Accounts and DIR-managed agencies such as Health and Human Services and the Railroad Commission replace IBM virtual tape libraries and tape management with AMI Cloud VTL and ATOS-hosted VTL solutions that leverage S3-compatible storage. This modernizes mainframe backup and archival, improving disaster recovery resilience while reducing storage and infrastructure costs.
ppt_source_file: FY26 State of Texas 10X Mindset - Jeff Ebbrecht AM 08292025.pptx

use_case_title: Batch and File-Transfer Observability with Control-M Workflow Insights
description: Agencies such as the Texas Comptroller of Public Accounts, TxDOT, and Health and Human Services extend their managed file transfer environments by adding Control-M Workflow Insights. This provides deeper analytics and visibility into end-to-end workflows, enabling proactive issue detection, SLA management, and optimization of critical batch and data-movement processes.
ppt_source_file: FY26 State of Texas 10X Mindset - Jeff Ebbrecht AM 08292025.pptx
